_note: Playstyle for the Pyre beatdown deck: throw as many Strikes as possible every turn and ride the duelist's high Strike Table damage, climb aspects on Fervor toward the Ascension win, and spend life cards on the Mastery to get attacks past blocks. Few defenses; the stop-alls are the defense. Openers that shut off answers (forbids) go first.
name: pyre_beatdown
